question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined words.

He was __not willing__ to attend the technical session of the conference.
solution:
The correct answer is Option i.e. **"Reluctant"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Reluctant **- Feeling or showing aversion, hesitation, or unwillingness i.e. **not willing **(अनिच्छुक)

 
 
• **Example**: He was reluctant to answer the question.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is "Reluctant".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dejecting** - Making someone feel unhappy or disappointed. (निराशाजनक)
 
• **Curious **- Having a strong desire to know or learn something. (उत्सुक)
 
• **Comprehensive **- Of large scope; covering or involving much; inclusive. (व्यापक)
